```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true

imdb_years <- c(2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2022)

imdb_urls <- c(
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20150101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20170101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20190101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20210101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20220201012049/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/"
)

fetch_imdb_snapshot <- function(address, snapshot_year) {
  response <- request(address) |>
    req_timeout(120) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
    req_perform()
  resp_check_status(response)

  page <- read_html(resp_body_string(response))
  rank_table <- page |>
    html_element("table.chart") |>
    html_table()
  vote_counts <- page |>
    html_elements("td.ratingColumn.imdbRating strong") |>
    html_attr("title") |>
    str_extract("(?<=based on )[0-9,]+") |>
    str_remove_all(",") |>
    as.integer()

  if (nrow(rank_table) != 250L || length(vote_counts) != 250L) {
    stop("Expected 250 chart rows and 250 rating tooltips.")
  }

  rank_table |>
    select(`Rank & Title`, `IMDb Rating`) |>
    separate_wider_delim(
      `Rank & Title`,
      delim = "\n",
      names = c("rank", "title", "year")
    ) |>
    mutate(
      snap_year = snapshot_year,
      rank = parse_number(rank),
      title = str_trim(title),
      year = parse_number(year),
      rating = as.double(`IMDb Rating`),
      number = vote_counts
    ) |>
    select(snap_year, rank, title, year, rating, number)
}

imdb_snapshots <- map2_dfr(imdb_urls, imdb_years, fetch_imdb_snapshot)
```

```{r}
imdb_snapshots |>
  count(snap_year)
```

```{r}
imdb_rank_changes <- imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year %in% range(snap_year)) |>
  select(title, year, snap_year, rank) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = snap_year, values_from = rank, names_prefix = "rank_") |>
  drop_na(year, rank_2015, rank_2022) |>
  mutate(
    release_decade = floor(year / 10) * 10,
    rank_change = rank_2022 - rank_2015
  )

imdb_rank_changes |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarise(average_rank_change = mean(rank_change), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(release_decade)
```

```{r}
imdb_snapshots |>
  distinct(title, year, snap_year) |>
  count(title, year, name = "snapshot_count") |>
  count(snapshot_count, name = "film_count") |>
  arrange(snapshot_count)
```
